text: After a long journey, Leo arrived in Luntian with his family. They had moved to the quiet village to start a new chapter, and Leo was the new kid in town.
While his family settled into their new home, he stepped outside, excited to explore but a little nervous about starting over.
The village felt unfamiliar. As Leo followed a narrow path, he noticed that many people used signs to communicate.
A young girl waved when she noticed Leo seemed unsure where to go. As the new kid in town, he saw a chance to make his first friend in Luntian. Choose a response by signing.
